applicability: A single-folder read (GET /api/notes/folder) naming a readable-but-unsearchable directory (read permission without search, e.g. mode 0o444) under the notes root.
conditions: _folder_row skips each entry whose stat fails instead of listing it, so the folder answer carries exists true with empty entries and zero total.
Family examination: no joint obligation is supported. Basis: unchanged — a ruled exception bounding the byte-identity member, expressed for single-folder reads.

Dated allegation corrected additively (MEMORY A1, L126-MEM-01): the interim _list_names revision is retracted — no such construct exists in the tree; the 200-empty answer pre-dates the repair attempt via per-entry skips, and the initial EACCES-at-listdir premise for readable folders was refuted (R6 4e6ba5f5, final option-a 2f477f8a).
exclusions: Swapped-away (ELOOP/ENOTDIR) and bad-descriptor (EBADF) folders still answer empty-with-reason.
A missing folder and a file path keep their own reasons.
A searchable-but-unreadable folder (e.g. mode 0o111) and a neither-read-nor-search folder (e.g. mode 0o000): EACCES from the folder open or listing propagates and the baseline 500 is preserved.
statement: An unlistable notes folder answers present with no children: each entry's stat failure is skipped, never listed, so a readable-but-unsearchable folder yields zero rows with exists true.
